text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш's two strongest opponents at
the
spring Tenno Sho are Manhattan
Cafe and Zenno
Rob Roy. Suddenly
compelled, she boldly
approaches
them...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And issues them a challenge. This
sudden
declaration is brought on by her
newfound desire
to run for the thrill of
the action.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The three of them will race down this

3,200-meter path to prove whose
reason for
racing is "right."
text_block_list.name: Монолог
